data_issues: Labels y in train and val are shifted by one class relative to the stimulus log: every trial has y = (movie_time_s - 1) mod 10 (e.g. movie_time 0 s labeled 9, 1 s labeled 0). The movie_time_s field matches the class definitions, so y is mislabeled (off-by-one). I relabeled with class = movie_time_s before training.
